arStrings.szText: Return to Deckard Cain at the Imperial Library of Caldeum

I did it. Or rather "we" did it, Aidan and I. I found him inside his nightmare, still searching for his brother. Together we faced and slew the Echo of Diablo, and when the time came, I took the Splinter of Terror. Aidan and Albrecht's souls can finally rest in peace. I must tell Deckard and grant him peace as well.
